DSEA.Settings.StatusOptions.Name: Status Effects
DSEA.Settings.StatusOptions.Label: Configure Statuses
DSEA.Settings.StatusOptions.Hint: Choose which statuses appear in the Token HUD palette and the duration the "Default" choice applies to each. Hidden statuses stay visible on tokens that already have them, so they can be removed.
DSEA.Settings.Locked: This status never has a duration
DSEA.Settings.ClickHint: In the palette: left-click adds a status or raises its value by the step, right-click lowers the value (removing the status at 0) or removes a status without a value, Shift+left-click toggles the overlay.
